title: Money-Mule Detection as a Relational Learning Problem: A Study on the RBIH NFPC Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.21314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Money-mule networks move criminal funds through many small transfers, each of which looks ordinary on its own. What marks an account as a mule lies outside any single transfer: in the counterparties and addresses its network shares, and in the shape of its activity over time. Production systems remain largely rule-based and see neither, while most research classifies transactions rather than accounts, recovering account-level risk only by aggregating afterwards. We instead score the account directly, reading the bank's relational schema as a heterogeneous graph in which rows are nodes and foreign keys are edges. Each account is scored from a multi-hop neighbourhood using per-column encoders, a relative-time encoding and HeteroGraphSAGE message passing, with that neighbourhood restricted to rows predating the account's own pre-flag cutoff so that no model sees evidence recorded only after the account was flagged. translated_title: 将钱骡检测作为关系学习问题：基于RBIH NFPC数据集的研究
translated_abstract: 钱骡网络通过大量小额转账来转移犯罪资金，每一笔转账单独来看都显得很普通。将一个账户标记为钱骡的特征并不存在于任何单笔转账之中，而是隐藏在其网络所共享的交易对手方和地址，以及其活动随时间演变所呈现的形态之中。生产环境中的系统在很大程度上仍基于规则，两者皆无法识别；而大多数研究是对交易而非账户进行分类，只能通过事后聚合来间接获得账户层面的风险。我们转而直接对账户进行评分，将银行的关系模式解读为一张异构图，其中数据行作为节点，外键作为边。每个账户的评分基于多跳邻域计算，采用逐列编码器、相对时间编码和HeteroGraphSAGE消息传递，并将该邻域限制在该账户自身预标记截止时间之前已存在的行，从而确保任何模型都不会接触到仅在账户被标记之后才记录的证据。在一个为期五年的印度储备银……
tldr: 该研究将钱骡账户检测建模为关系学习问题，把银行关系数据库转化为异构图，通过带时间截断的多跳图消息传递直接对账户评分，避免了事后聚合和数据泄露问题，并在RBIH NFPC五年真实数据集上进行了验证。
en_tdlr: This study frames money-mule detection as a relational learning problem, converting the bank's relational schema into a heterogeneous graph and directly scoring accounts via time-cutoff-restricted multi-hop HeteroGraphSAGE message passing, evaluated on the five-year RBIH NFPC dataset.
